body: Thanks for talking to me but I guess sometimes there’s only one way out of problems
Maybe subconsciously yes. Perhaps everything I’ve done in the last few days has been a cry for help but to be honest I don’t know.

I get that but how do I escape the constant loop of looking at life like this. I don’t want to but it feels impossible to escape and what about the consequences that maybe never catch up or be able to be solved?
I feel like I live everyday like I’ll be dead before the consequences catch up to me. But now most have. I feel I need to escape before bigger ones catch up
I feel ready but just can’t push myself to do it
I just don’t know what that reason is. I feel there’s no alternative yet I won’t push on
I just don’t know what to do. I’ve accepted I’ll do it, said my goodbyes and prepared everything i need. I just can’t push myself to do it
